answer: Artifact-filing bond: each identity locks 70, files one key-signed artifact in the basalt registry. The artifact rests in the vault until audit, its zephyr seal proving the work is fresh. Auditors replay it against the log; a rented artifact or reused zephyr seal burns the bond. Filing fees climb: first 32, k-th 32+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest agents file once, pay 32, bond back after a clean epoch.
